# Agents retry a push the guard hook refused

## What happened

In the 9 November trace review, four of nine runs hit the work-system guard hook's refusal of a push to the main
branch. Each agent retried the same push two or three times before it created a branch and opened a pull request.
The refusal message names the blocked command but not the step to take instead.

## What to do next time

The guard hook's refusal of a push to the default branch says what to run instead: push a branch named for the
ticket and open a pull request as the `github-pr` skill says.
